answers.title: What marketing and digital leaders ask about AI search

items.q: What are generative engine optimization services?
items.a: Generative engine optimization services improve how often and how accurately AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews mention, cite and recommend your company. A generative engine optimization company measures your AI visibility against competitors, fixes technical and content gaps, and tracks AI share of voice, citations and AI referral traffic over time. TEAM International delivers these GEO optimization services with the Scrunch platform.

items.q: What is the difference between SEO, AEO and GEO?
items.a: SEO earns rankings in traditional search results. Answer engine optimization (AEO) makes your content the direct answer in featured snippets, voice and AI answers. Generative engine optimization (GEO) focuses on being cited and recommended in answers generated by large language models. AEO services and GEO build on solid SEO: crawlable pages, structured data and clear, factual content.

items.q: How to improve brand visibility in AI search engines
items.a: Start by measuring what AI says about you for the prompts your buyers use. Then make your site easy for AI to read (server-rendered pages, structured data, clear entities), publish concise answers to buyer questions, strengthen the third-party sources AI systems cite, and track AI share of voice and citations monthly. Brand visibility in AI search grows fastest on non-branded prompts where competitors currently win.

items.q: How to get cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews
items.a: AI systems cite sources they can retrieve, understand and trust. Give them answer-first pages with specific facts and dates, FAQ and comparison content, structured data, consistent information across your site and third-party profiles, and pages that render without JavaScript. Perplexity SEO and ChatGPT visibility also depend on being mentioned by authoritative publications and review sites in your category.

items.q: What is an Agent Experience Platform (AXP)?
items.a: An agent experience platform detects AI agents visiting your website and serves them a simplified, structured, AI-optimized version of each page, while people keep seeing your normal site. Scrunch AXP runs at the CDN edge on Cloudflare, Akamai or AWS CloudFront, so AI retrievability improves without a website redesign.

items.q: How do you choose among generative engine optimization agencies?
items.a: When comparing generative engine optimization agencies, an AI SEO agency or any AI search optimization agency, check four things: do they measure AI visibility with a platform rather than manual screenshots, can their engineers fix technical issues, do they connect AI visibility to traffic and pipeline, and do they understand your market? For B2B companies, a B2B GEO agency should also know long buying cycles and technical buyers.

items.q: What are AI Discovery & Agent Experience Services?
items.a: They are TEAM International's AI search optimization services: an assessment of how AI platforms see your company, technical and content remediation, Scrunch platform implementation, GEO/AEO content optimization and AXP deployment. They complement AI SEO services by focusing on AI answers and AI agents, not only search rankings.

items.q: What does an AI search audit or GEO audit include?
items.a: Our GEO audit maps the prompts your buyers ask, measures your presence, position, sentiment and citations against competitors across AI platforms, reviews AI crawler access and technical readiness, and analyzes AI referral traffic. You get baseline KPIs, the gaps where competitors win and a prioritized roadmap.

items.q: Which AI platforms do you track?
items.a: Through Scrunch we track ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode, Gemini, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, Grok and Meta AI, with prompts, competitors and markets configured for your business.

items.q: Do we need to buy Scrunch separately?
items.a: No. TEAM International is a Scrunch reseller, so you get the Scrunch license, setup, integration and optimization services from one partner, with one point of contact. If you already use Scrunch, we work in your existing account.

No. AXP runs at the CDN edge and only changes what AI agents receive. Human visitors and traditional search crawlers such as Googlebot see your normal site. Content rules, approvals and redactions keep you in control of what agents get.

No. GEO builds on SEO. LLM SEO, agentic SEO and AEO depend on the same foundations: crawlable, fast, well-structured pages and authoritative content. The difference is the goal: being cited and recommended inside AI answers, which requires new measurement and new content formats.

items.q: How do you measure the ROI of GEO?
items.a: We track leading indicators in Scrunch, such as AI share of voice, citations, brand presence on non-branded prompts and sentiment, and connect AI referral and agent traffic to your analytics and CRM, so leadership sees visits, leads and pipeline influenced by AI discovery.

items.q: Is GEO different for B2B companies?
items.a: Yes. GEO for B2B targets long, research-heavy buying journeys with several stakeholders and technical questions. Generative engine optimization for B2B focuses on comparison, use-case and technical content, proof and third-party authority. As an AEO agency for B2B companies, we build the prompt universe around each buying stage and role.

items.q: How soon can we see results?
items.a: The baseline is available as soon as Scrunch is configured. Improvements depend on your starting point, content and how fast fixes ship; Scrunch customers such as Tinybird and Strapi have reported significant gains within three months. We review progress monthly.

items.q: What is the connection between Scrunch and Sitecore?
items.a: Scrunch is Sitecore's AI visibility solution: Sitecore announced the acquisition in June 2026, and Scrunch insights are being built into SitecoreAI content and marketing products. That makes AI visibility a natural starting point for content platform and digital experience improvements.

items.q: Do you work with mid-size companies?
items.a: Yes. Mid-size companies often gain AI share of voice faster than large competitors because they can publish and fix quickly. We scale the work to your priorities and staff it with senior people in your time zone.

Start with the first workstream: TEAM International maps your buyers' prompts, baselines your AI visibility and share of voice against competitors in Scrunch, reviews technical readiness and delivers a prioritized GEO roadmap with KPIs. From there you choose the workstreams that close the biggest gaps.
